normalize_numbers_text: normalize numbers in text by converting digits to words for TTS preprocessing
expand_dollars_amount: expand dollar amounts like $12.50 to twelve dollars and fifty cents in text
expand_ordinal_numbers: expand ordinal numbers like 1st or 2nd to first or second in text
expand_decimal_numbers: expand decimal numbers like 3.14 to three point one four in text
remove_commas_numbers: remove commas from numbers like 1,000 to 1000 in text
